description: <attemptDir>/gate-exit.json. Published once by the gate after the agent exited and every other process of the domain was killed and reaped (linux-gate: kill(-1, SIGKILL) then waitpid(-1) until ECHILD). Never published by anyone else.

fields.exitCode: integer or null (null when the agent died by a signal)
fields.cause: string or null; copied from stop-requested.json cause when the gate received SIGTERM/SIGINT and that file exists; `hard-ceiling` when the gate's own ceiling fired; `abandoned-before-brief` or `orphan-result` for the terminal orphan branch

stoppedByRule: agent: the agent exited on its own (no SIGTERM to the gate, no ceiling)
soft-deadline | idle | output-limit | cancel: the gate received SIGTERM/SIGINT and read that cause from stop-requested.json; SIGTERM/SIGINT without the file is stoppedBy cancel with cause "signal"
